description: Real kiosk scan request transaction with the production request settings memo enabled; N3 and N8 children present. Excludes pre-request device authentication. Admission preserves cancellation precedence. Measured on a fixed school Monday (2026-08-24), the path of every care weekday: it includes the day's pickup exception and pickup note reads, which a weekend skips (2 statements fewer). 7e1548adb7 had measured a Saturday with the wall clock (#6266). Activity-limit admission now runs under the session row lock; the existing-child and session-occupancy checks share one tenant-scoped query, saving one statement without changing request settings memoization.
